what_differs: On 08-18 WagerTech said it will roll duplicate player accounts into a person account and send that person ID, which is not built yet. Testing uses the current ID, and WagerTech will swap and resend later. Player_External_Id__c is the upsert key for survey completion (WAGR-46/441). No ticket tracks the swap, the re-key of existing players, or a re-test.
suggested_action: Create a dependency ticket (owner: WagerTech, with Jumpr re-test). Confirm the swap date. Decide how existing Player records get the new external ID (re-key, or match by email and update). Re-test the SLC and survey upserts after the swap.
